title: xi cutscene definition
description: One full cutscene: cast + dialog + camera shots + step timeline. Compiled to (1) event bytecode appended to the actor block in the zone Event DAT, (2) dialog strings appended to the zone Dialog DAT, (3) camera Route + EffectRoutine sections appended to the referenced scene resource DAT. Verified against Maat event 93 (Ru'Lude Gardens, ROM/21/52.DAT) as the retail reference profile.

eventId.description: Event id on the owning actor. 'auto' = max(existing real ids) + 1.

actor.description: Cast id (from cutscene_npc) that OWNS this event — its actor block gets the new event id. Server Lua `player:startEvent(id)` runs against this actor's entity.

oneOf.description: Path (relative to this file) to a cutscene_npc.json
Path (relative to this file) to a cutscene_dialog.json

flags.description: Presentation flags. Defaults are dialog-mode (no cinematic opcodes) — retail dialogue events don't emit 0x20/0x42/0x46/0x38 and the client handles player-freeze + Enter-popup + music continuity automatically. Cinematic flags require the scene-DAT writer (not shipped) to look right.

lockPlayer.description: Emit 0x20 lock_player. Not needed for dialog — the message box auto-freezes the player.

cameraLock.description: Emit 0x46 camera control mode 1. Triggers a client fade-to-cinematic. WARNING: needs scene-DAT fdi1 routine to fade back — leaves screen black otherwise.

eventMode.description: 0x38 CliEventModeLocal bitfield. Client reads only the high byte (HIBYTE|0x20). See docs/events/event_mode_bits.md.

talkAnim.description: 4-char gesture tag played while a line is on screen (0x66 sched_ext2). Overridable per line.

idleAnim.description: 4-char gesture tag the NPC returns to after each line (0x5E stop_action).

hideActorsOnEnd.description: Emit 0x4E 01 (hide) for every non-player, non-owner cast NPC during the epilogue's fade-to-black, so no explicit Hide keyframes are needed at the end. Status-6 NPCs re-hide at teardown anyway; this covers actors whose default state is visible.

hideNpcNames.description: Hide the floating name tag + health bar over every non-player, non-owner cast NPC. NOT an event opcode — applied server-side at publish (npc_list.namevis |= 0x20; namevis is the high byte of packet 0x000E Flags3, bit 29 = name-not-rendered per XiPackets) to the live DB + custom-NPC registry SQL; needs a map-server restart. Turning it back off restores the bit.

resetZoomOnEnd.description: Restore the client's default camera zoom (projection focal 350) under the epilogue's fade-to-black. Camera routes set the GLOBAL projection focal and nothing resets it when the event ends — without this the player keeps the last shot's zoom after the cutscene. Emitted as a dur-0 'zres' still (focal 350) fired before 0x46 camera 00; skipped when the cutscene has no camera shots.

totalFrames.description: Cutscene duration in frames (30fps). Used by timeline mode to lay out keyframes; ignored in step mode.

autoFadeIn.description: Auto-emit an fdi1 fade-in of this many frames at start. 0 = no fade.

autoFadeOut.description: Auto-emit an fdo1 fade-out of this many frames at the end. 0 = no fade.

timeline.description: Timeline authoring mode — an alternative to `steps`. When both are present, `timeline` wins. Tracks group keyframes by kind (dialog / npc / music / sfx / vfx / camera / fade / face). Compiler walks all keyframes in frame order, emitting the matching opcode + wait-time gaps between them.

kind.description: Track type — determines which opcodes its keyframes emit.

castId.description: For npc/dialog/face tracks: which cast id this track applies to. Omit for global tracks (music, camera, fade).

frame.description: Frame index (30fps) when this keyframe fires.

op.description: Optional opcode override. If absent the compiler picks based on track.kind + keyframe fields.

camera.description: Camera shots. Each shot becomes a paired 0x06 Route (spline) + 0x07 EffectRoutine (timeline) in the scene resource; a step { op: 'camera', shot: <id> } emits 0x45 start_task with the shot's FourCC tag.

sceneDat.description: Full ROM path of the scene resource DAT to append shots into. 'auto' picks a compatible existing scene DAT referenced by this zone, or allocates a new file_id.

tag.description: 4-char FourCC written into 0x45 start_task and used as the EffectRoutine's section name (e.g. 'w005'). Convention: 'wNNN' for camera shots; 'fdo1'/'fdi1' for fades; 'ovl1' for overlays.

smoothing.description: Route interpMode. 0=mixed(default), 1=multi-point spline (most common in retail), 4=variant, 2/3 rare. Curve-per-value not fully pinned yet.

look.description: Look-at point in FFXI world space.

fov.description: Field-of-view in degrees. Encoded as int(fov*10) (decidegrees).

roll.description: Camera roll in radians. Retail typically ~0.

steps.description: The ordered scene beats. Each step lowers to a fixed opcode template. Labels enable branching (`goto`/`branch`).

oneOf.description: Speaker-less message (0x48).

tag.description: 4-char routine/clip tag on the actor's motion package (e.g. 'grt0', 'idl0', 'fg00').

loop.description: 0 = loop forever, N≥1 = play N times then hold. Matches routine 0x05 maxLoop.

oneOf.description: 0x4E render-flag show.
0x4E render-flag hide.
0xBA calibrate_entity_position mid-scene (also emitted implicitly at scene start from cast entries).
0x5D music volume.

options.description: Option rows; the choice index (0-based) lands in Work_Zone[0].

text.description: Dialog line id used as the question. The compiler appends the options to it as one string (retail layout) in a new line <id>__menu.

cursor.description: An integer constant (goes to references[]) or a register spec.

hidden.description: Option indexes to hide (bit i of the 0x24 hide mask).

hide.description: An integer constant (goes to references[]) or a register spec.

oneOf.description: 0x24 dialog_menu + 0x25 wait_select.

on.description: 'menu_result' (Work_Zone[0], default) or {"work": n} for Work_Zone[n] (server replies land from Work_Zone[2]).

cases.description: Keys: option index as a string ("0", "1", ...) or "cancel" (Escape = 254). Values: step labels.

default.description: Label to jump to when no case matched.

oneOf.description: One 0x02 if (kind 1: equal → jump to the absolute label offset) per case, then an optional 0x01 set_exec to default.
0x01 set_exec: unconditional jump to a step label (absolute scene offset).

from.description: Register spec: {"param": n} (server parameter n = Work_Zone[2+n]), {"work": n}, {"work1700": n}, {"local": n}, or "result" / "menu_result".

oneOf.description: 0x03 get_store Work_Zone[1] = value: what the server reads as `option` on the next 0x05B (end or server_update).

wait.description: Emit 0x43 01 to block until the server answers (player:updateEvent).

oneOf.description: 0x43 00: send packet 0x05B mode 1 → onEventUpdate(player, csid, option).

item.description: An integer constant (goes to references[]) or a register spec.

oneOf.description: 0x93: open the item description window for an item id (constant or register); "close" / 0 closes it.

digits.description: Maximum input length (retail: 2 for 1..99, 4 for 1..1000, 9 for gil).

style.description: Window style; 1 in every retail use.

result.description: Register spec: {"param": n} (server parameter n = Work_Zone[2+n]), {"work": n}, {"work1700": n}, {"local": n}, or "result" / "menu_result".

oneOf.description: 0x71 numeric window: 71 12 p1 p2 (sized) or 71 10 p1 (plain), then 71 13 / 71 11 stores the number in result (default Work_Zone[4]).
0x71 text window (71 00 open, 71 01 wait); the client sends the text in packet 0x060.

from.description: An integer constant (goes to references[]) or a register spec.

into.description: Register spec: {"param": n} (server parameter n = Work_Zone[2+n]), {"work": n}, {"work1700": n}, {"local": n}, or "result" / "menu_result".

oneOf.description: 0x40: into.bits[lo..hi] = from << lo (default into = result).

from.description: Register spec: {"param": n} (server parameter n = Work_Zone[2+n]), {"work": n}, {"work1700": n}, {"local": n}, or "result" / "menu_result".

into.description: Register spec: {"param": n} (server parameter n = Work_Zone[2+n]), {"work": n}, {"work1700": n}, {"local": n}, or "result" / "menu_result".

oneOf.description: 0x41: into = from.bits[lo..hi] >> lo.

server.description: player:getCurrency name for the Lua stub, or gil.

oneOf.description: Retail-shaped currency shop: dispatcher + cloned Isakoth page routine + item/price tables. Server: startEvent(csid, 0, balance, 0, 0, 0, limit); updateEvent(balance, 0, 0, 0, 0, limit).
Print texts[index]: the strings are appended contiguously and the event prints message (first + register). Field Manual regime descriptions work this way.
0x73 spell/ability visual from one entity to another (Nomad Moogle effect 244), then a 0x1C pause of wait frames.

result.description: Stored in Work_Zone[1] before 0x21 so onEventFinish(player, csid, option) sees it.

oneOf.description: 0x21 end_event. Auto-appended if omitted.

server.description: Server-side wiring hints. Emitted as a Lua stub for the user to paste into the owning NPC script.

examples.description: Minimal Maat greeting — study distilled from event 93
